key_evidence_spans: A 46-year-old Japanese woman with a history of epilepsy presented with redness and swelling of the right breast
Ultrasound revealed a 54 × 41 × 31 mm low-echo mass with partially unclear margins in the outer right breast
Biopsy showed invasive ductal carcinoma (no special type), high grade, ER+, PgR–, HER2 3+, Ki67 70%
Whole-body PET-CT revealed increased uptake in the right axilla, anterior mediastinum, left pleura, and liver, consistent with cT4dN3M1 stage IV breast cancer
CT and MRI of the head revealed a 30-mm mass lesion in the right temporal lobe

She received four cycles of FEC chemotherapy, after which lesions nearly disappeared, and then trastuzumab plus pertuzumab with docetaxel, achieving a clinical complete response maintained for 23 months
